forum: First-tier Tribunal (Social Entitlement Chamber) - Social Security and Child Support
purpose: Create a proportionate, issue-led derivative from a frozen internal master without serving the whole master record.
authority_order: Tribunal Procedure (First-tier Tribunal) (Social Entitlement Chamber) Rules 2008 as currently in force
current Social Security and Child Support Tribunal practice statements/guidance

pack_sections.title: Appeal control sheet
contents: decision date and decision under appeal

pack_sections.title: Concise appellant case
contents: burden or evidential point only where legally material

pack_sections.title: Issue-led chronology
contents: only events necessary to decide the appealed issues
each material entry linked to an exact source/document/page

pack_sections.title: Evidence relied upon
contents: unedited original-form documentary evidence unless a lawful redaction applies
medical or functional evidence where relevant
financial or administrative evidence only where relevant to the appealed issue
adverse evidence necessary for fair presentation

pack_sections.title: Respondent response audit
contents: documents relied upon but not supplied

pack_sections.title: Appellant reply and further evidence
contents: reply only to live disputed points
further evidence ledger with date supplied and source

pack_sections.title: Participation and reasonable adjustments
contents: record of request and tribunal response

pack_sections.title: Hearing-day control
contents: questions likely to require factual answer

evidence_rules.relevance_gate: EXCLUDE material that does not help decide a live appealed issue or comply with a direction.
evidence_rules.original_form: Documentary evidence is supplied unedited in original form unless the tribunal rules/guidance permit withholding/redaction.

redaction.rule_14: Use tribunal confidentiality procedure where serious harm/interests-of-justice test is engaged.
redaction.administrative_contact_exception: Non-material administrator contact details may be removed where current SEC guidance permits, with an explanation of what was removed and why.
must_not_remove: witness of fact or opinion identity

evidence_rules.duplicate_control: Only one authoritative copy unless duplication is necessary to explain a chronology or direction.
evidence_rules.adverse_material: Do not hide materially adverse evidence; identify it and address its weight/relevance.
evidence_rules.provenance: Every derivative item must map to an immutable source identity and exact page/occurrence where possible.

required_checks: all documents in respondent possession relevant to the case appear to have been supplied unless directed otherwise
new reasons distinguished from original decision reasons
each respondent assertion mapped to a document/page or marked unsupported

technical_output_gate.clickable_index: OPTIONAL_FOR_SSCS_UNLESS_USEFUL_OR_DIRECTED; do not import civil-court bundle rules wholesale into tribunal procedure
technical_output_gate.continuous_pagination: USE_FOR_GENERATED_DERIVATIVE_CONTROL, but do not assert civil court e-bundle guidance governs SSCS

release_gates_before_live_use: identify exact appealed decision and live issues
build respondent Rule 24 audit when response exists
prohibited_shortcuts: serve all 54 R59 PDFs merely because they exist
edit source evidence to improve presentation
remove names of material decision makers/assessors/examiners/witnesses
treat internal analysis as expert evidence
claim the technical builder itself establishes legal compliance
use civil court e-bundle guidance as if it automatically governs SSCS
